blocks.text: I am unable to change the setting for "Alert for Unknown/Suspicious C2 Traffic" under Advanced Threat Protection. I switch between `true` and `false` for the option `alert_for_unknown_or_suspicious_c2_traffic` but nothing changes in Experience Center.

This will need to be escalated to API engineering for analysis. Regardless of the value configured in the UI the attribute `alertForUnknownOrSuspiciousC2Traffic` is always being returned as false, and igoring the input value i.e true which causes Ansible to think there is a difference in configuration when there isn't. This isn't a Ansible problem directly but an API issue.
